test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What can one infer from the passage?

options.text: Nurses’ intervention reduce vulnerability to fear in pregnant mothers.
Control group without nurses’ support have relatively elevated mental development.
The community plays an important role in offering social support to mothers.

solution:
The correct answer is **"Option 4"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage highlights the intervention of nurses who visited pregnant mothers, **supporting them.**
 
• This support extended even after childbirth, with approximately twenty visits made by the nurses before the children turned two years old.
 
• This inference can be drawn from the fact that **the nurses provided support to the pregnant mothers**, and this support had lasting benefits for the children even fifteen years later.
 
• It suggests that **community support can positively impact child development**.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **"The community plays an important role in offering social support to mothers."**

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
